content.comment_body: How are the bits in the shift register set to 1? You can also create output sequences, like for lights in a supercar. Thanks.

The state present at the input of the shift register is transferred when the trigger transitions from low to high. Bits shift based on the direction input – if low, all bits are moved up (from S1 to S8); if high, they shift down (from S8 to S1). You can refer to the help section for a good example. There’s also a sample program called "shift register" located in the [company_name] program folder. Regards, [user_name]
A I 0.0 = M 0.0 A I 0.1 = M0.1 so you can load the input to byte M0. A I 2.0 FP M5.0 JCN NEW1 L MWO SLW 1 // shift left by one T MWO NEW1 : NOP 0
